_comment: Agent-decomposed variant of queries-k8s.json for the 3-arm seeded-context experiment (RFC-021 / #462 Direction E). Each query carries `seeds`: the candidate symbol NAMES a k8s-savvy agent would produce from the QUERY TEXT ALONE (not reverse-engineered from `expect`). The harness bench/run-seeded-k8s.mjs runs three arms per query — A: get_context(query); B: get_context(seeds joined as a query string); C: get_seeded_context(seeds array) — and compares hitRank. `expect`/`category` are unchanged from queries-k8s.json so hits are scored identically.
